# PR #3455: Patch: a job ran over 7 minutes

Closes #3436

## What changed and why

`db (store contract)` ran 7m02s because every `cargo` call in `tests/db/run.sh` recompiled `jackioh-server` from scratch. The cause was a dead root in `crates/server/build.rs`: `RULES` listed `"../cards/data"`, which no longer exists (the compiled win-rate table retired), and Cargo treats a missing `rerun-if-changed` path as changed on every run. Five `cargo` calls (build, `--list`, three shards) meant five compiles, serialized on Cargo's build lock.

- [build.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3436/crates/server/build.rs): deleted `"../cards/data"` from `RULES`; module doc now states every root must exist and points at the guarding test.
- [checkpoints.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3436/crates/server/tests/actor/checkpoints.rs): new `the_rules_fingerprints_roots_all_exist` test asserting every `RULES` root exists, so a future dead root fails fast instead of silently costing minutes.
- [run.sh](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3436/crates/server/tests/db/run.sh): comment-only paragraph after the `PROFILE_FLAGS` comment documenting the invariant; no command changed.
- [README.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3436/crates/server/README.md): one sentence in the "Tests" paragraph noting every hashed root exists.

## How I tested it

- New test failed red before the fix: `build.rs hashes roots that do not exist, so Cargo recompiles the crate on every call: ["../cards/data"]`. After the fix: `actor::checkpoints::` 9 passed, 0 failed.
- Freshness: two consecutive `cargo test … -p jackioh-server --test server_store store::postgres -- --list` runs; the second printed only `Finished 'test' profile [unoptimized] target(s) in 0.15s` with no `Compiling`.
- Fingerprint unchanged: compiled the pre- and post-fix build scripts with `rustc` and ran both from `crates/server`; both print `JACKIOH_RULES_FINGERPRINT=02898d9c3c38d6ba` (value differs from the plan's quoted one because the tree state differs; equality old==new is the invariant that keeps stored checkpoints valid).
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, and `spec check` (1853 rulings, 4770 proofs: ok) all pass, plus `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance ci_scope_runs_a_crates_groups_for_every_file_it_includes_from_outside_it` for the new `include_str!`.
- `tests/db/run.sh` end to end was **not** run: Docker is unavailable on this machine. The PR's own `db (store contract)` run is the proof, and any CI time improvement is an estimate, not a measurement.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- One deviation from the plan: `cargo fmt` reformatted the new test (multi-line asserts, `'"'` char literals); semantics identical to the plan's exact copy.
- Per the plan: removed the dead root rather than skipping missing roots in the script (a skip would hide the next dead root); did not recreate `crates/cards/data/`; did not raise `DB_SHARDS`; added no perf guard to `run.sh`; no `.github/` change, so if `main` still shows the job over 5 minutes, the remaining lever is a shard matrix on `db-suite` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, which needs a person. No ruling: this is a build fix, so no `R<n>` id appears in any comment or test name.

## Reviewer notes

- The fingerprint equality check above is the load-bearing claim for #1169 checkpoint compatibility; the `actor::checkpoints::` suite passing corroborates it at runtime.
- `crates/server/Dockerfile`'s stage-caching comments now hold again (no recompile), producing the same binary; `db_deploy` is not enabled by this change, so a red `db (deploy …)` on `main`/daily is the signal to report.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

</details>

## Goal

`db (store contract)` finishes well under 5 minutes. No shard count can split it, because `scripts/ci-shards.toml` and `matrix.py` cover only `rust-test`, `web` and `e2e`. The cause is a bug, not a lack of shards:

- `crates/server/build.rs` lists `"../cards/data"` among its `RULES` roots and prints `cargo:rerun-if-changed=../cards/data` for it.

| | Before | After (dead root removed) |
|---|---|---|
| `run.sh` end to end | 3m19s | 1m22s |
| Shard `cargo test` compile step | 34 s, 1m11s, 1m48s | 0.3 s each |

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/server/build.rs` | change | Delete `"../cards/data",` from `RULES`. Replace the last sentence of the module doc. |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/checkpoints.rs` | change | Add `#[test] fn the_rules_fingerprints_roots_all_exist` at the end of the file. |
| `crates/server/tests/db/run.sh` | change | Comment only: a paragraph after the `PROFILE_FLAGS` comment. It also turns `db_store` on in the pull request, so the PR's own `db (store contract)` run shows the new time. |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | One sentence in the "Tests" paragraph (about line 1257–1262). |

Must not touch:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
- `scripts/ci-shards.toml` and `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`: no count applies here.
- `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`.
- `spec/`: this is a build fix, not a rules decision, so there is no ruling. Do not write an `R<n>` id in any comment or test name; `spec check` reads those.
- `crates/cards/patches/`: no catalog change.

Governing text: CLAUDE.md rule 12 (report only what you ran) and `crates/server/README.md`'s "Tests" section. The checkpoint fingerprint (#1169, `actor/checkpoint.rs`) must not change value.

## Steps

1. **Add the test first (red).** In `crates/server/tests/actor/checkpoints.rs`, after the last test `every_state_of_a_whole_game_checkpoints_and_passes_its_checks`, add the test below. It needs no new `use`; `std::path::Path` is written in full, as `std::sync::Arc` is elsewhere in the file. Copy this exactly:

   ```rust
   /// Every root `build.rs` hashes into `RULES_FINGERPRINT` exists. Cargo takes a `rerun-if-changed`
   /// path that is missing for changed on every run, so one dead root (`../cards/data`, deleted when the
   /// compiled win-rate table retired) recompiled this crate on every `cargo` call: the five of them in
   /// tests/db/run.sh took `db (store contract)` past seven minutes (#3436).
   #[test]
   fn the_rules_fingerprints_roots_all_exist() {
       let build = include_str!("../../build.rs");
       let list = build
           .split_once("const RULES: &[&str] = &[")
           .and_then(|(_, rest)| rest.split_once("];"))
           .map(|(list, _)| list)
           .expect("build.rs declares RULES");
       let roots: Vec<&str> = list
           .lines()
           .filter_map(|line| line.trim().strip_prefix('"')?.split('"').next())
           .collect();
       assert!(roots.contains(&"../engine/src"), "the scan found no root: {roots:?}");
       let missing: Vec<&str> = roots
           .iter()
           .copied()
           .filter(|root| !std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join(root).exists())
           .collect();
       assert!(
           missing.is_empty(),
           "build.rs hashes roots that do not exist, so Cargo recompiles the crate on every call: {missing:?}"
       );
   }
   ```

   `include_str!("../../build.rs")` resolves to `crates/server/build.rs` (the file sits in `tests/actor/`). That stays inside the crate, so `acceptance.rs`'s include scan ignores it. `Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join(..)` is not the `concat!(env!(..), "..")` pattern that scan flags (`crates/server/tests/api/catalog.rs:563` does the same).

2. **Run it and see it fail**: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::checkpoints::the_rules_fingerprints_roots_all_exist`. The message must list `["../cards/data"]`. If it passes, stop and re-read the steps.

3. **Fix `crates/server/build.rs`.**
   - Delete the line `"../cards/data",` from `const RULES` (between `"../cards/catalog.json",` and `"../cards/patches",`).
   - In the module doc, replace the final sentence `A root that is missing hashes as nothing.` with: `Every root must exist: Cargo takes a missing \`rerun-if-changed\` path for changed on every build, which recompiled this crate on every \`cargo\` call (#3436; tests/actor/checkpoints.rs holds the list to it).`
   - Change nothing else. The fingerprint value stays `4834960cb01cc9e3`. I checked this by compiling both versions of the script: a missing root adds no bytes to the hash.

4. **Run the test again (green)**: the same command as step 2.

5. **Check that cargo calls are fresh.** Run this twice, the second time must not print `Compiling`:

   ```
   cargo test --config profile.test.package.jackioh-engine.opt-level=0 --config profile.test.package.jackioh-cards.opt-level=0 --config profile.test.package.jackioh-ai.opt-level=0 -p jackioh-server --test server_store store::postgres -- --list
   ```

   The second run should show `Finished` in well under a second.

6. **`crates/server/tests/db/run.sh`, comment only.** Directly after the existing comment paragraph that ends `a different profile is a different build, so one call without them compiles it all again.` (just above `PROFILE_FLAGS=`), add:

   ```
   # Each call must also find the build fresh. A `cargo:rerun-if-changed` naming a path that does not
   # exist is stale on every call, and crates/server/build.rs named one (`../cards/data`, deleted with the
   # compiled win-rate table), so the build, the `--list` and each shard compiled the server again, one
   # after another on cargo's build lock: the job ran 7 minutes (#3436). A call that compiles nothing
   # takes under a second.
   ```

   Change no command in the script.

7. **`crates/server/README.md`, "Tests" paragraph.** Replace

   ```
   `PROFILE_FLAGS`, which each of its `cargo` calls repeats (CI's `db (store contract)` job stays under five
   minutes, #3162, #3410). A
   ```

   with

   ```
   `PROFILE_FLAGS`, which each of its `cargo` calls repeats, each finding the build fresh because every root
   `build.rs` hashes exists (CI's `db (store contract)` job stays under five minutes, #3162, #3410, #3436). A
   ```

   Keep the text after `A` as it is.

8. **If Docker works where you run**, run `sh crates/server/tests/db/run.sh`. Each shard's section must hold no `Compiling` line, and the log ends with three `test result: ok`. If Docker is not available, say so in the report and do not claim this was run.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/actor/checkpoints.rs`: `the_rules_fingerprints_roots_all_exist`.
  - It asserts that the scan finds `../engine/src` among the roots.
  - It asserts that every root in `build.rs`'s `RULES` exists under `crates/server`.
  - It fails on the unfixed tree, naming `../cards/data`, and passes after step 3.
- Commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::checkpoints::`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store store::postgres -- --list`, twice (step 5).
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- Optional, slow: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance ci_scope_runs_a_crates_groups_for_every_file_it_includes_from_outside_it` confirms the new `include_str!` is not flagged. The harness's workspace test runs it anyway.

## Done when

- [ ] `"../cards/data"` is gone from `RULES`; the fingerprint value is unchanged.
- [ ] The new test failed before step 3 (quote its message) and passes after.
- [ ] Two `cargo test … --list` runs on the server crate: the second compiles nothing.
- [ ] `run.sh` has the comment, `README.md` the sentence, and no script command changed.
- [ ] If Docker was available: `run.sh` shows no `Compiling` in the shards, with the time you measured. Otherwise the report says it was not run.
- [ ] Harness checks green: rustfmt, `catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, clippy (workspace), cargo tests (workspace, with no diff in `apps/web/src/wire`), web tests.
- [ ] The report names no check green that did not run, and states that CI's time is an estimate, not a measurement. The pull request's own `db (store contract)` run is the proof.

## Risks

- **Fingerprint and checkpoints** (#1169): a changed value would make every stored match checkpoint refuse and fold its whole log. It does not change: `files_under` returns nothing for a missing path, and both script versions printed `4834960cb01cc9e3`. Do not reorder or edit any other `RULES` entry.
- **Deploy image** (`crates/server/Dockerfile`): its comments say the `build` stage compiles nothing the `crates` stage did, but the dead root forced a recompile. That now holds, so the stage should be faster and produce the same binary, since the fingerprint is the same. This pull request does not turn on `db_deploy` (`scripts/ci-scope.sh` lists no `build.rs` there), so the push to `main` and the daily run are what test it. A red `db (deploy …)` job there is the signal to report.
- **A root added later that does not exist** now fails the new test (in the `server` test group) instead of silently costing minutes.
- **Estimated headroom**: about 1 minute under 5. If the next `main` run still shows `db (store contract)` over 5 minutes, the remaining lever is a shard matrix on `db-suite` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, which only a person can make.

## Decisions (what the task did not settle, and what I rejected)

- Removing the dead root, rather than printing `rerun-if-changed` only for roots that exist. That would hide a future dead root, and the new test catches it.
- Not recreating an empty `crates/cards/data/`, which would put back a directory the retirement deleted.
- Not raising `DB_SHARDS` from 3 to 4: it saves about 10 s and loads Postgres harder.
- Not adding a "no `Compiling` after the build" guard to `run.sh`: the unit test covers the known cause, and a perf check in a shell script can fail on noise.
- Not splitting the job: the bot cannot edit `.github/`, and every shard would repeat the compile and the five recompiles.

## Open questions

None that need a person.
